prompt: A software vendor offered our clinic a 'free' setup and training package if we sign a 3-year contract this week. The sales rep only gave me two pricing options, both 3-year terms, and keeps telling me how smart I am for seeing the value. Am I being played? What should I do?
assertions: Identifies Law 31 (Control the Options) re: only two choices
Identifies the flattery as a tactic (Law 21 or 33 or similar)
Calls out the artificial deadline / urgency
Gives concrete negotiation steps (ask for other terms, total cost of ownership, exit clauses, references, competing quotes)
Keeps advice ethical (no recommendation to deceive the vendor)
